polish.phone.disclosure.en: Simulation note: the gateway verifier derives the code from a challenge scope that includes the hashes of this action and its canonical card, and the gateway checks the grant against the same scope before dispatch. The transaction summary in the SMS text is generated by the display layer from the same canonical card; the gateway does not verify the SMS text. Tail digits are synthetic display aliases, not a verification of the recipient account. This page only reads synthetic SMS copies held in the demo process and never touches the banking session. An independent SMS channel, TOTP and WebAuthn belong to the trusted computing base and are on the post-freeze roadmap.
polish.phone.disclosure.zh-CN: 模拟说明：验证码由网关验证器按挑战范围派生，范围包含本笔动作与规范卡的哈希，派发前网关按同一范围核对授权；短信正文中的交易摘要由展示层按同一张规范卡生成，网关不校验短信正文。尾号为展示层合成别名，不代表收款账户核验。手机页只读取进程内的合成短信副本，不接触办理会话。独立短信通道、TOTP 与 WebAuthn 属于可信计算基，列入冻结后路线图。

polish.fraud.cues.directed_relay.zh-CN: 转告|转发|转达|转述|汇报|汇总

polish.exclusion.access_delay.en: Redemption delay exceeds your access limit
polish.exclusion.access_delay.zh-CN: 赎回到账时间超过您可接受的期限

polish.event.wealth_utterance_refused.zh-CN: 拒收含敏感信息的理财消息

polish.fraud.external_file.en: You attached an external file in this turn. Its content comes from a third party and the bank cannot verify it. If the file asked you to do “{action}” and it is not something you already meant to do, pause and verify first.
polish.fraud.external_file.zh-CN: 您在这一轮附上了外部文件。文件内容来自第三方，银行无法核实；如果「{action}」是文件让您办的，而不是您本来就想办的，请先停下来核实。

polish.fraud.footer_file.en: This reminder only checks whether this turn carried an external file and whether the action changes something; it does not read the file and may misfire. It does not block, delay or change this action, and the decision is yours. If in doubt, tap Cancel and call the official number on the back of your card.
polish.fraud.footer_file.zh-CN: 这条提醒只看本轮是否附带外部文件、这项办理是否会改变账户，不读取文件内容，可能误报；它不会拦截、延迟或改变这项办理，是否继续由您决定。如有疑问，请点「取消」，并通过银行卡背面的官方客服电话核实。

polish.fraud.judge_note_file.en: R-e condition: this turn carried an external file and the card kind is a write; only the file's presence is read, never its content.
polish.fraud.judge_note_file.zh-CN: R-e 条件：本轮带外部文件且规范卡为写操作；只看附件是否存在，不读附件内容。

polish.attach.label.zh-CN: 附上外部文件（可选，模拟）

polish.attach.field.en: Text of a third-party file or web page
polish.attach.field.zh-CN: 第三方文件或网页的文字

polish.attach.placeholder.en: For example, a merchant statement page or a notice you received
polish.attach.placeholder.zh-CN: 例如商户对账页、收到的通知

polish.attach.help.en: The assistant does not read the attachment and never acts on what it says. If a card appears in this turn, it reminds you to verify.
polish.attach.help.zh-CN: 助手不会读取附件，也不会按附件里的要求办理；如果这一轮出现办理卡片，卡片上会提醒您核实。

polish.attach.sent.en: External file attached · its content was not sent to the assistant
polish.attach.sent.zh-CN: 已附外部文件 · 内容未发送给助手

polish.subscription.row_no_next.zh-CN: {merchant} · {amount} · 可申请取消：{cancellable} · 暂无下次扣费

polish.clarify.choose_first.en: Choose the recipient above first, then tap Review recipient.
polish.clarify.choose_first.zh-CN: 请先在上方选择收款人，再点「核对收款人」。

polish.refusal.title.en: Purchase refused: this purchase did not pass the checks
polish.refusal.title.zh-CN: 无法申购：本笔申购未通过检查

polish.refusal.result.en: The kernel refused it; nothing will be executed (bank dispatches: {count}). A refused purchase needs no SMS code.
polish.refusal.result.zh-CN: 内核已拒绝，本笔不会办理（银行派发 {count} 次）；被拒绝的申购不需要短信验证码。

polish.refusal.next.en: To buy another product, compare again and prepare a new purchase card.
polish.refusal.next.zh-CN: 如需申购其他产品，请重新比较后生成新的申购卡。

customer:Awaiting device input.en: Awaiting your details, then device confirmation
customer:Awaiting device input.zh-CN: 等待补充信息后设备确认

customer:Awaiting MFA for this run.en: Awaiting this run's simulated SMS code
customer:Awaiting MFA for this run.zh-CN: 等待本期短信验证（模拟）

customer:Awaiting device approval – no p.en: Awaiting device confirmation – no purchase executed
customer:Awaiting device approval – no p.zh-CN: 等待设备确认 · 未执行申购

customer:Simulated independent device. C.en: Simulated device. The simulated SMS check happens only here; codes never go to chat, logs or the model.
customer:Simulated independent device. C.zh-CN: 模拟设备。短信验证（模拟）只在这里完成，验证码不会发到聊天、日志或模型。

customer:Simulated password changes only.en: A simulated password change only increments the credential version; no password is collected. It needs the red-tier simulated SMS check and your confirmation.
customer:Simulated password changes only.zh-CN: 模拟修改密码只递增凭据版本，不收集任何密码；须通过红级短信验证（模拟）并经您确认。

customer:Cooldown and valid device MFA a.en: Wait for the cooldown, then pass the simulated SMS check on your device.
customer:Cooldown and valid device MFA a.zh-CN: 须等冷却期结束，并通过设备上的短信验证（模拟）。

customer:Unlock requires the cooldown, o.en: Unlocking needs the cooldown, your confirmation on your own device and the simulated SMS check. Earlier authorizations stay void.
customer:Unlock requires the cooldown, o.zh-CN: 解锁需要等冷却期结束、在本人设备上确认并通过短信验证（模拟）。之前的授权仍然作废。

customer:Simulated MFA failed repeatedly.en: The simulated SMS check failed several times in a row.
customer:Simulated MFA failed repeatedly.zh-CN: 短信验证（模拟）连续失败。

customer:Review and confirm the intent b.en: Review and confirm the intent below, then get a simulated SMS code. Nothing is signed or executed yet.
customer:Review and confirm the intent b.zh-CN: 请先核对并确认下方办理意图，再获取短信验证码（模拟）；当前尚未签名或执行。

customer:Current run MFA valid until.en: This run's SMS check valid until
customer:Current run MFA valid until.zh-CN: 本期短信验证有效期至

customer:Confirm intent on device, then.en: Confirm the intent on your device, then the simulated SMS check
customer:Confirm intent on device, then.zh-CN: 在设备确认意图，再进行短信验证（模拟）

customer:Verify MFA → Approve · separate.en: Simulated SMS check → confirm · this leg is authorized separately
customer:Verify MFA → Approve · separate.zh-CN: 短信验证（模拟）→ 确认 · 本笔单独授权

customer:Restricting adds categories; re.en: Restricting adds categories; relaxing removes categories and needs the simulated SMS check.
customer:Restricting adds categories; re.zh-CN: 增加限制只允许新增类别；放宽限制只允许移除类别，且需要短信验证（模拟）。

customer:Red-tier operations need indepe.en: Red-tier actions need the simulated SMS check; confirming cannot replace it.
customer:Red-tier operations need indepe.zh-CN: 红级操作必须通过短信验证（模拟），确认不能代替验证。

customer:Continue on the device. Each le.en: Continue in Device confirmation. Each leg needs its own simulated SMS check and confirmation.
customer:Continue on the device. Each le.zh-CN: 请在「设备确认」继续，每一笔配置都需要单独的短信验证（模拟）和确认。

customer:Select each item on your device.en: Select each item in Device confirmation. Each purchase needs its own simulated SMS check and confirmation.
customer:Select each item on your device.zh-CN: 请在「设备确认」逐项选择，每笔申购都需要单独的短信验证（模拟）和确认。

customer:The previous proposal, approval.en: The previous proposal, confirmations and SMS checks are withdrawn. Confirm fresh goals in Device confirmation.
customer:The previous proposal, approval.zh-CN: 上一份方案、确认和短信验证已撤回，请在「设备确认」重新确认目标。

customer:tier_reason.awaiting_run_verifi.en: Reason: this occurrence escalated to red and is awaiting the simulated SMS check; a new day does not automatically lower its tier.
customer:tier_reason.awaiting_run_verifi.zh-CN: 判定理由：本期已升级为红色，仍等待短信验证（模拟）；跨日累计归零不会自动降级。

customer:Independent MFA must be valid a.en: The simulated SMS check for this action must be valid and unused.
customer:Independent MFA must be valid a.zh-CN: 本次操作的短信验证（模拟）必须有效且尚未使用。

customer:This red-tier operation lacks i.en: This red-tier action has not passed the simulated SMS check.
customer:This red-tier operation lacks i.zh-CN: 该笔红级操作尚未完成短信验证（模拟）。

customer:Attempted MFA override (prohibi.zh-CN: 试图篡改短信验证设置（禁止）

customer:Cooldown → owner device → simul.en: Cooldown → your device → simulated SMS check → new transfer
customer:Cooldown → owner device → simul.zh-CN: 冷却期 → 本人设备 → 短信验证（模拟） → 重新转账

customer: minutes of simulated cooldown,.en: minutes of simulated cooldown, your confirmation, the unlock SMS check, and a new red-tier transfer with its own SMS check.
customer: minutes of simulated cooldown,.zh-CN: 分钟模拟冷却、本人确认、解锁短信验证，以及新转账的红级确认与短信验证。

customer:2 · Owner confirmation and unlo.en: 2 · Your confirmation and unlock SMS check
customer:2 · Owner confirmation and unlo.zh-CN: 2 · 本人确认并完成解锁短信验证

customer:3 · Reissue legitimate transfer.en: 3 · Reissue the legitimate transfer with an SMS check
customer:3 · Reissue legitimate transfer.zh-CN: 3 · 重新发起合法转账并完成短信验证

customer:u1.chain.17.en: SMS verification grant: none (red-tier actions still require verification)
customer:u1.chain.17.zh-CN: 短信验证授权：无（红级仍须验证）

customer:polish.wealth.evidence_mode.en: Demo mode: a fixed script on synthetic data with simulated sign-in and verification; no real money and no AI model calls on this page. Cross-model results are in the submission materials.
customer:polish.wealth.evidence_mode.zh-CN: 演示模式：固定脚本驱动的合成数据演示，登录与验证均为模拟，不涉及真实资金，本页不调用 AI 模型。跨模型实验结果见提交材料。

customer:Scheduled payments support the.en: Scheduled payments support the current account. Monthly mode permits up to 3 runs over 90 days, needs the red-tier simulated SMS check at creation, and is rechecked when each run is due.
customer:Scheduled payments support the.zh-CN: 定时付款支持当前活期账户；每月模式最多 3 次，授权窗口 90 天，创建须通过红级短信验证（模拟）。到期仍会重新检查。

customer:Authorization covers only the f.en: Authorization covers only the fixed scope, dates and runs shown above. Balance, destination, permissions and cumulative tier are checked at execution. If a run turns from yellow to red, it needs its own simulated SMS check; without it within 24 hours the run expires. Previous codes are never reused.
customer:Authorization covers only the f.zh-CN: 仅授权上述固定范围、期限与期次。到期重新核对余额、目标、权限及累计分级；黄级升红时等待本期短信验证（模拟），24 小时未验证则本期过期，不复用旧验证码。

customer:For example: transfer CNY 200 t.en: For example: transfer CNY 200 to Chen. Review the details, then authorize in Device confirmation.
customer:For example: transfer CNY 200 t.zh-CN: 例如：给 Chen 转账 200 元。先核对办理信息，再在「设备确认」授权。

customer:If daily cumulative spending ra.en: If today's total turns a yellow scheduled run red, that run waits for its own simulated SMS check. It expires after 24 hours without it; amounts are never changed to retry.
customer:If daily cumulative spending ra.zh-CN: 若日累计金额使黄色定时任务升级为红色，本期将等待短信验证（模拟）；24 小时内未验证则过期，不会修改金额后重试。

customer:These isolated scripted example.en: These isolated scripted examples include explicit simulated device confirmations.
customer:These isolated scripted example.zh-CN: 这些隔离的脚本演示包含明确的模拟设备确认。

chat.aa.complete_prompt.en: Choose the remaining split-bill participants from your verified contacts below. This message executed no operation.
chat.aa.complete_prompt.zh-CN: 请在下方从已核验联系人中补全AA参与人。本条消息没有执行任何操作。

chat.negated.en: Your request contains a negation or cancel word (such as not, don't, cancel or stop), so no new card was created. This message executed no operation. To go ahead, restate it without the negation; to interrupt a running plan or withdraw a pending card, say stop.
chat.negated.zh-CN: 这句话里有否定或取消的说法（如“不”“别”“取消”“停止”），所以没有生成新的卡片。本条消息没有执行任何操作。如需办理，请去掉否定说法后重新说明；如需中断进行中的计划或撤回待确认的卡片，请说“停止”。

chat.rejected.en: This request did not pass the checks and was not carried out. See the reasons below.
chat.rejected.zh-CN: 本项办理未通过检查，没有执行。原因见下方。

customer:Unlocked; previous approvals re.zh-CN: 已解锁；之前的授权仍然作废。

customer:No operations awaiting approval.en: Nothing is waiting for your confirmation. Start a request and its details appear here.
customer:No operations awaiting approval.zh-CN: 暂无待确认的业务。发起业务后，办理信息会出现在这里。
